explanation: The lemma is a very specific group-theoretic fact. Take an involution t and a subgroup A that commutes elementwise with its conjugate Aᵍ[t], with A ⊓ Aᵍ[t] = ⊥. Then every element of A·Aᵍ[t] that commutes with t has the form a·(t a t⁻¹) for some a ∈ A. The notation Aᵍ[t] does not occur in Mathlib. I found no Mathlib lemma about the diagonal or fixed points of t in a commuting product A·A^t. I did not run a broader content search of the Subgroup files. The proof is a direct elementwise computation, so I did not find a single Mathlib declaration that gives it.
